# PREMIUM R3 Senki
Run locally: python -m pip install Pillow==11.3.0 numpy texture2ddecoder
Then: python art/external/senki_pack.py --out Senki-R3-local
Then: python tools/assemble_public_art.py
Then: godot --path . -- --combat-video --private-capture --d2-pack=Senki-R3-local/LOCAL_SENKI_PACK.json
Pack is explicitly opt-in native review; no public Web publication of third-party assets. Devolution remains HOLD. All 58 groups processed, only exact candidate identities with five complete basic actions enter runtime. Source screen-right SE only; other directions and forms fall back to existing Naru art. Candidate ground anchor and frame timing are provisional. No generic cast from skill poses. XML-backed effects are previewed separately; only unambiguous frame IDs and named effect candidates can enter renderer. Public CI publishes reports/logs only, local GIFs and video remain on the runner. No combat or Save changes.
